The Valley City State Vikings are the intercollegiate athletic teams that represent Valley City State University (VCSU), located in Valley City, North Dakota.
The Vikings compete in the National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA) as members of the Frontier Conference.
VCSU sponsors varsity teams in men's and women's sports, with competition primarily against other institutions in the Upper Midwest and Rocky Mountain regions.

Facilities
Lokken Stadium
Lokken Stadium is the primary outdoor athletic facility at Valley City State University and home to the Valley City State Vikings football program. The stadium is located on the VCSU campus in Valley City, North Dakota, and hosts Viking football games as well as other university and community events..
W. E. Osmon Fieldhouse
The W. E. Osmon Fieldhouse is the primary indoor athletic facility on the campus of Valley City State University.
Constructed in 1960, the facility has a seating capacity of approximately 2,000 and serves as the home venue for the Vikings’ men's and women's basketball programs.
Commonly referred to as “The Bubble” by members of the campus and local community, the Osmon Fieldhouse is known for its compact design and game-day atmosphere during basketball contests
In addition to intercollegiate athletics, the facility is used for intramural sports, team practices, university commencement ceremonies, community events, and local high school basketball tournaments.
The fieldhouse also serves as a practice facility for several VCSU athletic programs throughout the year.
